paragraphs: Surety2000 operates a platform for electronic surety bonds, and states that it enables fully paperless eBond issuance, receipt, and verification across agents, contractors, and agencies. The company states that it has spent over 25 years building the infrastructure that makes electronic bonds possible. The site states that all parties to the bond must register with Surety2000 before a bond can be executed.

In the workflow described, the bonding agent executes the electronic eBond directly through the Surety2000 platform. The contractor obtains the eBond from Surety2000, and the bond is then submitted to the public agency for validation. Agencies receive the eBond and validate it through the Surety2000 platform.

The pages cite UETA and the ESign Act for the legal standing of electronic records and signatures. Surety2000 describes the Digital Staple as an addition to the security of electronic surety bonds. The home page states that Surety2000 is a member of the NIGP Business Council.

quote.text: Surety2000 replaces this manual process with a secure, real-time digital workflow.
